The Scalable 8-Port GPON OLT with 4 PON Ports is a high-performance optical line terminal designed for ISPs, telecom operators, and enterprise FTTH networks. Built with a scalable architecture, this GPON OLT supports high subscriber density, stable bandwidth allocation, and future network expansion. Its compact design and carrier-grade reliability make it ideal for FTTH, FTTB, and FTTC deployments.


This OLT supports advanced GPON features such as QoS, VLAN, multicast, and strong security mechanisms, ensuring efficient and secure fiber access network operations.


Key Features


  • Scalable 8-port architecture
  • 4 × GPON PON ports with high split ratio
  • High bandwidth capacity per PON port
  • Supports large-scale FTTH subscriber deployment
  • Carrier-grade stability and reliability
  • Advanced QoS, VLAN & multicast support
  • Easy network management and maintenance
